title: Config-change Impact Scan & Adaptive Bitshift Calibrator for Quant Profiles (AWQ/GPTQ int8/int4)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: build an automated impact-scan and threshold synthesizer that ties model/config changes (model weights, quant profile selection, AWQ/GPTQ recipes, scheduler flags) to measurable quality regressions for int8/int4 deployments. The goal is an actionable output: per-route fidelity delta, a recommended bitshift/threshold (rollback or accept) and a conservative gating boolean usable by rollout pipelines. Scope: - Support AWQ and GPTQ quant profiles across int8 and int4 variants - Evaluate on production-like cohorts (NLU, code, summarization, retrieval-augmented generation) - Use a hybrid metric suite (embedding distance drift, token-level semantic metrics, logits-KL, and human-labeled sentinel set) - Implement an adaptive bitshift calibrator that recommends minimal dequantization/bitwidth rollback or bias-correction when thresholds breached - Hook to Console: create an alert widget and a rollout gate API surface Deliverables: 1) Eval harness that runs on config-change CI and on scheduled drift scans 2) Threshold synthesis algorithm and an audit log of recommended actions 3) Dashboard tiles for per-route delta + root-cause signal breakdown 4) Playbook for on-call and release engineers (auto-rollback rules, canary policy suggestions) Constraints & assumptions: - Requires ephemeral AWQ/GPTQ build infra (GPU workers) for golden-run comparisons - Use existing eval data lake and annotated sentinel sets; we will add 3 new cohorts focused on long-tail prompts - Acceptance decisions must be conservative by default: prefer false positives (extra rollback) over false negatives (missed regressions)
acceptance_criteria: Automated job runs on every candidate model/config change and emits a JSON report in S3 with per-cohort deltas
Threshold synthesizer produces a human-readable recommended action and a numeric safety score
Integration: Console shows the top 3 delta signals and a single-pass gate boolean for rollout pipelines
End-to-end smoke: a known synthetic perturbation (introduced in tests) triggers the expected gate within CI
Runbook drafted and reviewed by Reliability and PM teams

2025-02-26 Miguel Ortega: Prototype run complete on small GPUs; observed correlated rise in logits-KL and embedding drift for certain code-completion cohorts. Saved artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/eng/ENG-130210/proto-run-20250226/

2025-03-05 Miguel Ortega: Implemented initial threshold synthesizer — uses ROC-style sweep over sentinel labels to pick conservative cutoff; pushing PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-evals/pull/453. Next: wire outputs to Console alerting API.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: AWQ/GPTQ builds are slow and can block CI. Mitigation: dedicated ephemeral worker pool + cache golden checkpoints
Risk: Metric false positives due to cohort mismatch. Mitigation: cohort stratification and holdout validation sets; conservative thresholds
Risk: Overfitting threshold to sentinel set. Mitigation: stratified sentinel labeling and periodic human audits
